reason: HFCL secured a USD 244 million (approx. INR 2,329 crore) long-term supply agreement for Optical Fiber Cables, a material contract win that directly boosts revenue visibility and order book for a company with a market cap around INR 12,000 crore.
why_now: Exchange filing dated 2026-09-01 announces the contract win; the stock can react immediately to the order inflow news.
source_headlines: HFCL Limited: HFCL Limited has informed the Exchange Intimation for entering into a long term supply agreement with a customer for supply of Optical Fiber Cables (OFC), worth USD 244 million approx. equivalent to Rs.2329 Crore approx.
